posts.title: Notes from week 46
posts.description: day10 now builds on every platform obuilder does: Linux, Windows, macOS and FreeBSD; CephFS spent the week being slow; monteverde’s replacement drive has the same fault as the one it replaced; and Greenland is nearly done.

posts.title: Tessera on Intel Endeavour: from 56 to 136 tiles an hour, and then the GPU gets the same treatment
posts.description: In my Intel AMX post I found that a few AMX cores could keep pace with a small GPU on the Tessera model. Since then, Intel has given us time on their Endeavour cluster, which is full of recent Xeons with no GPUs in sight. So I tried running the current model, the v2 pixel student, there.

posts.title: Notes from week 45
posts.description: day10 builds Windows packages again and agrees with GitHub Actions on all but a handful of explainable cells; OCaml 5 has been killed by Ctrl-Break since 2022; opam 2.6 reached every CI; a page cache saved 0.64 seconds; and one CephFS metadata server was doing all the work.
